Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misinterpreted the task by instructing the agents to find the winner of the 2019 BAFTA Games Awards (ceremony year), which led to “God of War” (2018), instead of identifying the 2019 game that won BAFTA Best Game (i.e., Outer Wilds, awarded at the 2020 ceremony). This early misdirection caused all subsequent steps to target the wrong Wikipedia page and produce an incorrect revision count.
